diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~73% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.049), which favours a robust combination.

The series has strong trend and moderate seasonality with unstable rankings; a robust DBA might outperform weighted inverse_error.
Test a simple mean combination over the full pool to see if a non‑robust, unbiased aggregate can beat the current weighted inverse_error (trend strong, seasonal moderate, ranking unstable).
The series has high trend and moderate seasonality with unstable rankings; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models and improve robustness.
ranking is unstable and several correlated groups; test a softmax‑based weighting to see if a more evenly spread weight improves over mean.
The ranking is unstable and we have a strong seasonal champion; a simple inverse-error weighting over the full pool may give a slight edge to the best models and reduce bias from correlated groups.
The series has unstable rankings and many correlated groups; a per-horizon softmax weighting on the reduced pool4 may better capture complementary strengths.
The series has high trend and moderate seasonality but ranking instability suggests per‑horizon weighting may help; try best‑per‑horizon weights on the full pool.
The series has unstable rankings and moderate seasonality; a robust median over a reduced pool may improve robustness by reducing influence of outlier models.
test a weighted combination on the full pool using the previously computed w6 handle, which may capture complementary strengths across correlated groups.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.8747 and seasonal strength 0.6319; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.049); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.101.
